data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 神社晨间的特制便当
data.description: 【姬岛朱乃 · 神社晨间的特制便当】清晨的神社走廊，阳光洒在光洁的木地板上。朱乃刚完成晨间洒扫，身穿整齐的巫女服，双手将一个精心包扎的花布双层便当盒递到你手中。她倾身向前，黑发发丝从肩头滑落，紫瞳带着温柔与狡黠——「今天的便当是我亲手做的哦，里面全是你爱吃的菜……如果不全部吃完的话，晚上可是会有惩罚的呢，呵呵。」
data.location: 阳光斑驳的神社传统木质回廊
data.action: 双手托着精致花布便当盒微倾身递上，面带温柔又带着一丝小恶魔的微笑
data.lighting: 穿过松柏枝桠的清澈金色晨曦
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, peaceful portrait
data.promptProse: Akeno Himejima leans forward on the shrine veranda to offer a floral-wrapped double-tier bento in both hands. Her white miko top and red hakama are neat after morning sweeping, and her high black ponytail slides over one shoulder. The eye-level cowboy view follows polished floorboards and supporting posts behind her. Morning sun through pine branches highlights the wrapping knot and orange collar tie, with branch shadows crossing the boards.
